title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
summary: Meet GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two models that bring frontier intelligence to everyday work with different balances of capability and cost.
title_es: OpenAI presenta GPT-6 Sol y Luna
bajada: OpenAI lanzó dos nuevos modelos de la serie GPT-6 con diferentes balances entre capacidad y costo. Los modelos están diseñados para optimizar el rendimiento según las necesidades específicas de cada caso de uso.
bajada_en: OpenAI launched two new GPT-6 series models with different capability-to-cost balances. The models are designed to optimize performance based on specific use case requirements.

title: Better prompt caching for GPT-6
summary: Learn how GPT-6 improves prompt caching with higher cache hit rates, new diagnostics, explicit breakpoints, and controls that reduce latency and costs.
title_es: GPT-6 mejora el caché de prompts con menor latencia
bajada: OpenAI mejoró significativamente el caché de prompts en GPT-6 con mayores tasas de éxito, nuevos diagnósticos y controles explícitos. Estas optimizaciones reducen latencia y costos para desarrolladores.
bajada_en: OpenAI significantly improved prompt caching in GPT-6 with higher hit rates, new diagnostics, and explicit controls. These optimizations reduce latency and costs for developers.

title: Claude Opus 5.5
bajada: Anthropic lanzó Claude Opus 5.5, la nueva versión de su modelo flagship. La actualización genera expectativa en la comunidad developer por sus potenciales mejoras.
bajada_en: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5, the new version of its flagship model. The update generates community excitement about potential improvements.

title: Meta’s Muse AI Assistant Rolled Out With a Serious Security Flaw
summary: Meta says it issued a fix for the Muse zero-day vulnerability that would have let attackers do “whatever” they wanted on a victim’s Mac, highlighting the inherent dangers of AI helpers.
title_es: Meta Muse sufre vulnerabilidad de seguridad crítica
bajada: Meta corrigió una vulnerabilidad zero-day en su asistente Muse IA que permitía a atacantes obtener acceso completo a Macs comprometidas. El incidente destaca riesgos de seguridad inherentes a agentes IA personales.
bajada_en: Meta patched a critical zero-day vulnerability in its Muse AI assistant that allowed attackers full access to compromised Macs. The incident highlights inherent security risks of personal AI agents.

title: NVIDIA Isaac ROS 5.0 Advances Agentic, Open Source Robotics Development
summary: To build and deploy sophisticated robotics applications that can perceive, reason and act in dynamic environments, developers need new physical AI models and tools. The ROS open framework is a project from Open Robotics that helps humans build robots. NVIDIA Isaac ROS 5.0 — a collection of GPU-accelerated packages built on ROS, released today at […]
title_es: NVIDIA Isaac ROS 5.0 acelera desarrollo de robótica agentic
bajada: NVIDIA lanzó Isaac ROS 5.0, una colección de paquetes GPU-acelerados para robótica. La actualización integra modelos de IA física y herramientas de código abierto para aplicaciones de robótica sofisticadas.
bajada_en: NVIDIA launched Isaac ROS 5.0, a collection of GPU-accelerated packages for robotics. The update integrates physical AI models and open-source tools for sophisticated robotics applications.

title: OpenAI nabs key Patreon execs ahead of upcoming announcement
summary: OpenAI has hired three former Patreon execs to anchor its product strategy for creators. After starting the creator subscription platform 13 years ago, cofounder and technology chief Sam Yam announced on X that he's joining OpenAI to lead Creator Product. He's also bringing Patreon's former product head Drew Rowny and engineering head Shannon Ma with […]
title_es: OpenAI contrata ejecutivos de Patreon para creadores
bajada: OpenAI fichó a tres ejecutivos de Patreon, incluyendo al cofundador Sam Yam, para liderar su estrategia de productos para creadores. El movimiento sugiere que OpenAI está expandiendo su enfoque hacia el ecosistema de creadores.
bajada_en: OpenAI hired three Patreon executives, including cofounder Sam Yam, to lead its creator product strategy. The move suggests OpenAI is expanding its focus toward the creator ecosystem.

title: **Know Who Spoke When: Build Real-Time, Multi-Speaker AI with NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Diarization**
title_es: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 diarización multiusuario en tiempo real
bajada: NVIDIA lanzó Nemotron 3 Diarization en Hugging Face para identificar quién habla en conversaciones multiusuario en tiempo real. La herramienta es útil para transcripción, análisis de reuniones y aplicaciones conversacionales.
bajada_en: NVIDIA launched Nemotron 3 Diarization on Hugging Face for real-time multi-speaker identification in conversations. The tool is useful for transcription, meeting analysis, and conversational applications.

title: YouTube will let you build your own algorithm with AI
summary: YouTube’s new custom feeds let users describe the videos they want to see in their own words, then use Gemini to build a personalized feed around the request.
title_es: YouTube permite crear feeds personalizados con IA
bajada: YouTube integró Gemini para que usuarios describan qué contenido quieren ver y generen feeds personalizados automáticamente. La funcionalidad ofrece una nueva forma de descubrimiento y personalización de contenido.
bajada_en: YouTube integrated Gemini to let users describe desired content and automatically generate personalized feeds. The feature offers a new approach to content discovery and personalization.

title: GPT-6 Astra has gained the ability to drive a car
title_es: GPT-6 Astra ahora puede conducir vehículos
bajada: GPT-6 Astra adquirió capacidad de conducción autónoma según benchmark de DrivingBench. El desarrollo marca un avance en aplicaciones multimodales de modelos IA avanzados.
bajada_en: GPT-6 Astra gained autonomous driving capabilities according to DrivingBench benchmarks. The development marks progress in multimodal applications of advanced AI models.

title: Rabbit Is Back, This Time With an AI Agent App
summary: Two years after trying to sidestep mobile apps with dedicated AI hardware, Rabbit is launching OS3, a cross-platform agent that lives on the screens you already use.
title_es: Rabbit lanza OS3, agente IA multiplataforma
bajada: Rabbit presentó OS3, un agente IA multiplataforma que reemplaza su apuesta anterior en hardware dedicado. La nueva estrategia busca llegar a usuarios a través de dispositivos y pantallas existentes.
bajada_en: Rabbit launched OS3, a cross-platform AI agent replacing its previous dedicated hardware approach. The new strategy aims to reach users across existing devices and screens.

title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna
title_es: GPT-6 Sol y Luna generan gran interés en comunidad tech
bajada: El lanzamiento de los nuevos modelos de OpenAI acapara la atención en plataformas como Hacker News. La noticia refleja el interés sostenido de developers en las nuevas capacidades de OpenAI.
bajada_en: OpenAI's new model launch captures significant attention on platforms like Hacker News. The news reflects sustained developer interest in OpenAI's latest capabilities.

title: OpenAI extends cyber access to Ukraine for civilian defense
summary: OpenAI is extending access to its Daybreak program to the Government of Ukraine to support the cyber defense of civilian infrastructure.
title_es: OpenAI extiende programa Daybreak a Ucrania
bajada: OpenAI amplió su programa Daybreak de ciberseguridad al Gobierno de Ucrania para reforzar la defensa civil. La iniciativa refleja el compromiso de OpenAI con aplicaciones de IA para seguridad crítica.
bajada_en: OpenAI expanded its Daybreak cybersecurity program to Ukraine's Government for civilian defense. The initiative reflects OpenAI's commitment to AI applications for critical security.

title: Grab and OpenAI bring practical AI skills to Southeast Asia
summary: OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI, a regional programme helping 30,000 partners build practical AI skills across Southeast Asia.
title_es: Grab y OpenAI capacitan en IA a Southeast Asia
bajada: OpenAI y Grab lanzaron GO Forward with AI, un programa regional que capacitará a 30,000 asociados en habilidades prácticas de IA. El programa busca democratizar el acceso a herramientas de IA en la región.
bajada_en: OpenAI and Grab launched GO Forward with AI, a regional program training 30,000 partners in practical AI skills. The program aims to democratize AI tool access across the region.

title: OpenAI wants to consult elite mathematicians about how to not fumble again
summary: After turning a string of spectacular mathematical results into a reputational crisis, OpenAI is consulting human mathematicians to help it figure out a less disastrous path forward. On Monday, the company announced a new independent panel of mathematicians tasked with advising it and other AI companies on their interactions with mathematical research and the wider […]
title_es: OpenAI consulta a matemáticos élite sobre investigación
bajada: OpenAI creó un panel independiente de matemáticos para asesorar sobre interacciones con investigación matemática. La iniciativa responde a controversias previas sobre credibilidad de resultados matemáticos en IA.
bajada_en: OpenAI formed an independent panel of elite mathematicians to advise on mathematical research interactions. The initiative responds to previous controversies about AI mathematical credibility.

title: Stripe's Knowledge AI Platform
title_es: Stripe lanza plataforma de IA para conocimiento
bajada: Stripe presentó su Knowledge AI Platform para developers. La herramienta facilita la integración de búsqueda y contexto de IA en aplicaciones de pago y negocio.
bajada_en: Stripe launched its Knowledge AI Platform for developers. The tool facilitates AI-powered search and context integration in payment and business applications.
